title: Bridge Command Envelope
description: Bridge-side envelope schema. All fields Bridge must populate before sending to K0 command port. Mirrors k0 envelope.schema.json but with Bridge-specific constraints (idem_key required, sig computed).

cognitive_trace_id.description: Trace correlation ID. Propagated from K1 session or generated (UUID v7).

tenant_id.description: Family tenant ID from Bridge config.

space_id.description: Family space ID from Bridge config.

topic.description: Command topic. Must be registered in command_topics.yaml.

schema_uri.description: Per-topic body schema URI. Format: schema://k0/topics/{topic_base}.body.json

schema_version.description: Body schema version resolved from the schema $id.

device_id.description: Device ID from Bridge device registry.

band.description: Privacy band. Must be in allowed_bands for the topic.

policy_version.description: Current policy version from Bridge config.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp at envelope build time.

sig.description: Envelope signature computed by Bridge signing backend.

sig_alg.description: Signature algorithm. HMAC_SHA256 for dev, Ed25519SHA512 for production.

envelope_sha256.description: SHA-256 of full canonical envelope JSON (excluding sig fields).

idem_key.description: BLAKE3(topic + canonical_json(body) + device_id). Deterministic idempotency key. REQUIRED on Bridge side.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical_json(body). REQUIRED on Bridge side.

body.description: Domain payload. Must match the per-topic body schema referenced by schema_uri.
